title: Game setup
description: The lobby's setup document: everything a game's host decides before launch, sent whole to every player on each change. The host's launcher owns it; every player's engine must fly the same one.

revision.description: Raised by one on every change; a player keeps the highest revision it has seen.

build.description: The engine build every player must run, as the launcher names it.

host.description: The roster id of the player who opened the lobby and holds the setup.

path.description: The mission file, relative to the install folder, with forward slashes.

settings.description: The 17 game settings of the 1997 lobby's GAME_OPTIONS packet, in plain values; jedimaster.setup.engine_settings gives the engine's.

craft_selection.description: Who may choose a craft: nobody, everyone, or the host alone.

craft_waves.description: Reinforcement rounds of the players' flight groups.

mission_time_limit.description: Minutes, or none, or the mission's own.

last_team_time_limit.description: Minutes the last team standing has, or none.

random_seed.description: The seed every machine's flight starts from; the host draws it.

server_update_rate.description: The host's world updates a second.

continue_sequence.description: Whether a battle or campaign goes on after a mission.

password_required.description: Whether joining needs the password; the password itself never travels in this document.

rules.description: The 1997 game's behavior, or the fixed one.

changes.description: Named behavior changes the host turns on one by one, under fixed rules.

name.description: The pilot's name, at most 13 characters as the game keeps it.

flight_group.description: The mission flight group the player flies in, once assigned.

loadout.description: Option numbers from the flight group's lists; 0 keeps the mission's own.

build.description: The engine build this player's launcher reports.

teams.description: Up to 10 teams of up to 8 players; the first player of a team is its captain.

frozen.description: True once the host pressed Launch; nothing changes after.

fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 of the frozen document, as jedimaster.setup.setup_fingerprint computes it.
